people.name: Argob
people.line: A region in Bashan, known for its fortified cities.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

translations.web: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
translations.bsb: At that time we captured all sixty of his cities. There was not a single city we failed to take—the entire region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
translations.kjv: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
translations.asv: And we took all his cities at that time; there was not a city which we took not from them; threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
